tool:add_effect.text0: Apply an effect to a layer and optionally set its parameters in one undoable call. `effect` is an id (`ec.blur.gaussian`) or After Effects name (`Gaussian Blur`; see list_effects); `values` maps parameter ids to values, e.g. {"blurriness": 12}. Returns the instance `path` (`effects/#n`, for set_property / add_keyframe) and its parameters with their paths and current values.
tool:add_effect.desc: Apply an effect to a layer and optionally set its parameters in one undoable call. `effect` is an id (`ec.blur.gaussian`) or After Effects name (`Gaussian Blur`; see list_effects); `values` maps parameter ids to values, e.g. {"blurriness": 12}. Returns the instance `path` (`effects/#n`, for set_property / add_keyframe) and its parameters with their paths and current values.

tool:add_keyframe.params: {comp?:integer|string, interpolation?:string, keys?:array, layer*:integer|string, path*:string, time?:number, value?}
tool:add_keyframe.text0: Add keyframes to a property (turns the stopwatch on): one with `time` (+ optional `value`, default the current value) or many with `keys: [{time, value}]`, then optionally set their `interpolation`: linear, bezier, hold, easyEase, easyEaseIn, easyEaseOut. Example: {"layer":1,"path":"transform/position","keys":[{"time":0,"value":[0,540]},{"time":2,"value":[1920,540]}],"interpolation":"easyEase"}.
tool:add_keyframe.desc: Add keyframes to a property (turns the stopwatch on): one with `time` (+ optional `value`, default the current value) or many with `keys: [{time, value}]`, then optionally set their `interpolation`: linear, bezier, hold, easyEase, easyEaseIn, easyEaseOut. Example: {"layer":1,"path":"transform/position","keys":[{"time":0,"value":[0,540]},{"time":2,"value":[1920,540]}],"interpolation":"easyEase"}.

tool:batch.text0: Run several engine commands in one call as ONE undo step (engine.batch). Later steps can use earlier results: a string param "$N" or "$N.key" is step N's result (1-based), e.g. create a layer, then key and style it: {"steps":[{"command":"layer.newText","params":{"text":"Hi","name":"Title"}},{"command":"prop.addKey","params":{"layer":"$1.layer","path":"transform/opacity","time":0,"value":0}},{"command":"effect.apply","params":{"layer":"$1.layer","effect":"Glow"}}]}. Returns {steps, results}. If a step fails the whole batch is rolled back (unless atomic: false) and the error names the step.
tool:batch.desc: Run several engine commands in one call as ONE undo step (engine.batch). Later steps can use earlier results: a string param "$N" or "$N.key" is step N's result (1-based), e.g. create a layer, then key and style it: {"steps":[{"command":"layer.newText","params":{"text":"Hi","name":"Title"}},{"command":"prop.addKey","params":{"layer":"$1.layer","path":"transform/opacity","time":0,"value":0}},{"command":"effect.apply","params":{"layer":"$1.layer","effect":"Glow"}}]}. Returns {steps, results}. If a step fails the whole batch is rolled back (unless atomic: false) and the error names the step.

tool:control.text0: Call any control-channel method (docs/control-protocol.md) with its params, e.g. ui.menu.list, ui.menu.invoke {id}, ui.panel.show {panel}, ui.scroll, ui.viewer.locate {x,y}, ui.timeline.locate {layer,time}, ui.playback {action}, ui.resize.
tool:control.desc: Call any control-channel method (docs/control-protocol.md) with its params, e.g. ui.menu.list, ui.menu.invoke {id}, ui.panel.show {panel}, ui.scroll, ui.viewer.locate {x,y}, ui.timeline.locate {layer,time}, ui.playback {action}, ui.resize.

tool:describe_command.text0: One command in full: id, label, menu path, shortcut, the `params` doc, a JSON Schema of its parameters (`schema`: properties, required, additionalProperties) and whether it can run now (`why` if not). Use before execute_command when unsure of the parameters; execute_command rejects unknown keys.
tool:describe_command.desc: One command in full: id, label, menu path, shortcut, the `params` doc, a JSON Schema of its parameters (`schema`: properties, required, additionalProperties) and whether it can run now (`why` if not). Use before execute_command when unsure of the parameters; execute_command rejects unknown keys.

tool:execute_command.text0: Run any engine command by id with JSON params; edits are undoable. Examples: comp.new {"name":"Main","width":1920,"height":1080,"frameRate":30,"duration":5}; layer.newText {"text":"Hello","size":120,"fill":"#ffffff"} (returns {"layer":id}); layer.newSolid {"color":"#3366ff"}; layer.newShape; effect.apply {"layer":3,"effect":"Gaussian Blur"}; time.set {"time":2.5}; layer.select {"layers":[3]}. Layers are referenced by id, "#n" or name; times are seconds.
tool:execute_command.desc: Run any engine command by id with JSON params; edits are undoable. Examples: comp.new {"name":"Main","width":1920,"height":1080,"frameRate":30,"duration":5}; layer.newText {"text":"Hello","size":120,"fill":"#ffffff"} (returns {"layer":id}); layer.newSolid {"color":"#3366ff"}; layer.newShape; effect.apply {"layer":3,"effect":"Gaussian Blur"}; time.set {"time":2.5}; layer.select {"layers":[3]}. Layers are referenced by id, "#n" or name; times are seconds.

tool:get_comp.text0: A composition: id, name, size, frame rate, duration, work area, background and its layers top to bottom (id, index, name, type, in/out/start seconds, blend mode, parent, track matte, switches). Layer ids feed get_layer, get_property/set_property and commands.
tool:get_comp.desc: A composition: id, name, size, frame rate, duration, work area, background and its layers top to bottom (id, index, name, type, in/out/start seconds, blend mode, parent, track matte, switches). Layer ids feed get_layer, get_property/set_property and commands.

tool:get_layer.text0: A layer's property tree (transform, masks, effects, text, shape contents, ...): every node has a `path` usable with get_property/set_property/add_keyframe, plus uid, match id, name, type, value at `time`, keyframes and expression. `flat: true` returns just a list of {path, type, value, keys, expression} (compact).
tool:get_layer.desc: A layer's property tree (transform, masks, effects, text, shape contents, ...): every node has a `path` usable with get_property/set_property/add_keyframe, plus uid, match id, name, type, value at `time`, keyframes and expression. `flat: true` returns just a list of {path, type, value, keys, expression} (compact).

tool:get_project.text0: Project overview: file path, dirty flag, bit depth, every item (id, name, type Composition/Footage/Solid/Folder, size, duration, layer count), the active comp id, current time (s), selected layers and the undo stack.
tool:get_project.desc: Project overview: file path, dirty flag, bit depth, every item (id, name, type Composition/Footage/Solid/Folder, size, duration, layer count), the active comp id, current time (s), selected layers and the undo stack.

tool:get_property.text0: Read one property: type, value at `time` (comp seconds; default the current time), whether it is animated, its keyframes (time, value, in/out interpolation) and expression.
tool:get_property.desc: Read one property: type, value at `time` (comp seconds; default the current time), whether it is animated, its keyframes (time, value, in/out interpolation) and expression.

tool:get_state.text0: Where things stand: the editor state (active comp, current time, selected layers/keys/items, open comps, tool, work area) plus what this build can do (`app`: version, command and effect counts, GPU effects, import/export formats, After Effects parity summary). Cheap; call it to re-orient after a series of edits.
tool:get_state.desc: Where things stand: the editor state (active comp, current time, selected layers/keys/items, open comps, tool, work area) plus what this build can do (`app`: version, command and effect counts, GPU effects, import/export formats, After Effects parity summary). Cheap; call it to re-orient after a series of edits.

tool:history.text0: The branching undo history (History panel): without arguments lists every state {index, id, label, parent, depth (0 = working line, >0 = branch), current, future}; undoing and then editing keeps the undone states as a branch. With `goto` (an index or id from the listing) jumps to that state, on any branch, without losing the others.
tool:history.desc: The branching undo history (History panel): without arguments lists every state {index, id, label, parent, depth (0 = working line, >0 = branch), current, future}; undoing and then editing keeps the undone states as a branch. With `goto` (an index or id from the listing) jumps to that state, on any branch, without losing the others.

tool:list_commands.text0: List engine commands: id, label, menu path, shortcut, `params` doc (e.g. `{name?, width?, height?, frameRate?, duration? (s)}`) and whether it can run now (`why` if not). Every menu item, shortcut and panel gesture maps to one of these ids; run them with execute_command. Narrow with `filter` (e.g. `layer.new`, `keys`, `effect`).
tool:list_commands.desc: List engine commands: id, label, menu path, shortcut, `params` doc (e.g. `{name?, width?, height?, frameRate?, duration? (s)}`) and whether it can run now (`why` if not). tool:list_effects.text0: The effect registry: id, After Effects name, category, GPU and 32-bpc support. Narrow with `filter` (id, name or category text). Apply with add_effect.
tool:list_effects.desc: The effect registry: id, After Effects name, category, GPU and 32-bpc support. Narrow with `filter` (id, name or category text). Apply with add_effect.

tool:open_project.text0: Open a project: `path` to an .ecproj file, `demo: true` for the built-in demo project, or `new: true` for an empty project. Returns the project overview.
tool:open_project.desc: Open a project: `path` to an .ecproj file, `demo: true` for the built-in demo project, or `new: true` for an empty project. Returns the project overview.

tool:render_frame.text0: Render a composition frame (default: the active comp at the current time) and return it as a PNG image, longest side `max_side` (default 960, 0 = full size). `path` also writes the PNG to disk; `inline: false` returns only the metadata. Use it to check your work.
tool:render_frame.desc: Render a composition frame (default: the active comp at the current time) and return it as a PNG image, longest side `max_side` (default 960, 0 = full size). `path` also writes the PNG to disk; `inline: false` returns only the metadata. Use it to check your work.

tool:run_script.text0: Run JavaScript with an After Effects-style scripting object model (app, app.project, items.addComp, comp.layers.addSolid/addText/addShape/addNull/addCamera/addLight, layer.property("ADBE Transform Group").property("ADBE Position").setValueAtTime(t, v), Effects.addProperty("ADBE Gaussian Blur 2"), expressions, markers, renderQueue…). Every edit is an undoable engine command; app.beginUndoGroup/endUndoGroup make one undo step. Returns {ok, result (last expression value), output (writeLn/$.writeln/alert text), error: {message, line, column} | null}. File access is limited to the project folder unless the user allows scripts to write files.
tool:run_script.desc: Run JavaScript with an After Effects-style scripting object model (app, app.project, items.addComp, comp.layers.addSolid/addText/addShape/addNull/addCamera/addLight, layer.property("ADBE Transform Group").property("ADBE Position").setValueAtTime(t, v), Effects.addProperty("ADBE Gaussian Blur 2"), expressions, markers, renderQueue…). Every edit is an undoable engine command; app.beginUndoGroup/endUndoGroup make one undo step. Returns {ok, result (last expression value), output (writeLn/$.writeln/alert text), error: {message, line, column} | null}. File access is limited to the project folder unless the user allows scripts to write files.

tool:save_project.text0: Save the project to its current file, or to `path` (Save As, .ecproj).

tool:screenshot.text0: Screenshot of the live app window, or one panel (`Composition`, `Timeline`, `EffectControls`, `Project`, ...) or element id, as PNG (longest side `max_side`, default 1600). Use it to check what the UI looks like after an action.

tool:script_ui.text0: Drive ScriptUI windows that scripts opened (dialogs, palettes, dockable panels). action `list` (default): open windows; `get`: a window's control tree (type, name, text, value, checked, items, selection, bounds); `click`: press a button / toggle a checkbox / pick a radio button; `set`: type text, move a slider, pick a list item (index or text); `close`: close a window (`result` for a dialog's show(), default 2 = Cancel). Controls by id, "#id", properties.name or text. A dialog's script resumes when the dialog closes.

Controls by id, "#id", properties.name or text. A dialog's script resumes when the dialog closes.

tool:set_property.text0: Set a property. Without `time`: sets the static value (or a key at the current time if already animated). With `time`: adds/replaces a keyframe there, turning the stopwatch on. `expression` sets an After Effects-style JS expression ("" removes it). Returns the property as get_property does. Examples: {"layer":3,"path":"transform/opacity","value":50}; {"layer":"Title","path":"transform/position","value":[200,540],"time":0}; {"layer":3,"path":"transform/rotation","expression":"time*90"}.
tool:set_property.desc: Set a property. Without `time`: sets the static value (or a key at the current time if already animated). Examples: {"layer":3,"path":"transform/opacity","value":50}; {"layer":"Title","path":"transform/position","value":[200,540],"time":0}; {"layer":3,"path":"transform/rotation","expression":"time*90"}.

tool:ui_click.text0: Click an element by `id` (from ui_elements) or at `x`,`y` (points). `button`: left|right|middle, `count`: 2 for double-click, `modifiers`: {shift, alt, command, ctrl}.

note:bulk-edits-use-run-script.label: Bulk or repetitive edits: write one script and run it with run_script
note:bulk-edits-use-run-script.text0: For many similar edits (every layer, a loop, generated layers or comps, keyframes in bulk, building a whole scene) write one After Effects style JavaScript and run it with the run_script tool instead of hundreds of tool calls. note:camera-null-anchor-pan.label: Pan and zoom a whole 2D scene with a camera null: key the null's anchor point, not its position
note:camera-null-anchor-pan.text0: Parent every layer of a scene to one null at the comp centre and animate it as a camera. Zoom with its scale; pan by keying its ANCHOR POINT (anchor = point to look at - comp centre + [50, 50]) and keep its position at the comp centre, so the zoom always stays centred on screen. Panning with position moves the scale pivot off-screen.

note:parented-layer-position-space.label: Keyframing the position of a parented layer: values are in the parent's space, not comp pixels

note:script-parent-before-animating.label: Rig a character or object with null joints in a script: parent first, animate after
note:script-parent-before-animating.text0: When a script builds layers and parents them (layer.parent = null, or layer.setParent), parenting compensates for the parent's CURRENT transform, including keyframes and expressions it already has, so children jump. Build in two phases: create every layer and null with static transforms and set all parents first; only then add keyframes, path morphs and expressions (also on the nulls). The parenting keeps world position (it is jump-compensated).
